journey.name: wear restore background drops words
journey.description:
Leaving the app in the middle of a restore drops the words typed so far, so they do not linger in memory behind another app: coming back shows the start of the restore, and the word screens are empty again. Emulator and physical watch (on a watch, press the crown to leave the app and open it again from the launcher).
Precondition: Fresh app, see journeys/wear/README.md › Fresh app. Backend: none, the journey stops before the wallet is saved. The word screens block screenshots, so check them with `android layout` only.

actions.action: Type `abandon` three times (README › Typing several words, with the list cut to three times `abandon`)
Run `adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_HOME` and wait 3 s
Run `adb shell am start -n to.bitkit.dev/to.bitkit.wear.ui.MainActivity` and wait 2 s
Verify the title (tag "RestoreTitle") reads "How many words?"
Run `adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_BACK` to close the keyboard
Verify the word field (tag "RestoreWordInput") is empty, showing its placeholder "Word 1"
